items.title: Circle shareholder sues Trump, World Liberty and Steve Witkoff over crypto deals
items.summary: According to a Circle shareholder, the US president’s “corruption” through USD1 left the company unable to compete with stablecoins, harming USDC.

items.title: Interpol Cybercrime Sweep Recovers Over $105 Million, Nets 1,462 Arrests
items.summary: Angolan authorities seized more than 2,000 crypto-mining devices; a Nigerian probe traced more than $2.4 million in suspected fraud proceeds.

items.title: ChatGPT Teaches Messi Chess—On a Board It Set Up Wrong, With an Opening That Loses in Four Moves
items.summary: Lionel Messi’s ChatGPT ad has the AI teaching him chess on a board with kings and queens swapped, then suggesting an opening that loses in four moves on that board.
